# Isolated Vault integration fixture

This directory is a synthetic Vault for integration checks. Read `CATALOG.md`,
then the relevant `PROJECT.md` and existing task context. Update the maintained
feature in place; preserve original delivery checkpoints. A design-only request
does not authorise application code. Record decision, implementation and
verification independently. Use one assigned writer for shared documents and
record explicit handoffs in task context. Read `guides/markdown-style.md` for
writing preferences and `guides/task-tools.md` when retaining task utilities.
